notes: Setup: the sandbox Node was v22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24+; used the preinstalled /opt/node24 (v24.22.3). Bootstrap npm,submodule,reference with --allow-unpinned-reference took 221s (npm 10.9s, submodule 7.6s, reference build the rest). Baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+video-operator-registry test before any change: 70s, green (8 tests).
The differential file runs in about 17s with --maxWorkers=1 on this sandbox; the unit file in under 1s.

Float cases (any non-zero balance or pl) are gated to linux-x64 with constant titles; the gate is a precaution: no macOS arm64 difference was measured. Defaults, refusals and negotiation run everywhere.
Mutations: dropping Math.fround (double arithmetic) or rounding lrintf ties up each fail all six linux-gated tests.

preservel divides by zero for black and white inputs (1 - |2l - 1| = 0); IEEE inf/NaN propagate as in C and av_clipf (FFMIN(FFMAX)) maps NaN to 0, so these pixels become 0 natively and here; covered by the kernel and cube tests.
threads=1 is a generic option native accepts; it is refused here as an unsupported option.

Native negotiates every one of the 17 negotiation sources to a format with storage (gray/YUV -> rgb24, yuva420p -> argb), so registry examples need no format= prefix; three use one to cover gbrp, rgba and rgb24.
